result.title: DLS: Dual-Logic Graph Neural Networks with Chaos-Fuzzy Residuals for Robust Link Prediction
result.comment: Submitted to World Wide Web (Springer Nature) on January 5, 2026. Preprint version, currently under peer review
result.summary: Link prediction is a fundamental task in graph mining, critical for applications ranging from biological interaction discovery to recommender systems. While Message Passing Neural Networks (MPNNs) have achieved state-of-the-art results, they are fundamentally limited by the inadvertent suppression of high-frequency signals, as the recursive aggregation that stabilizes structural learning inherently leads to over-smoothing, rendering node representations indistinguishable in deep layers. This limitation is particularly severe in heterophilous graphs, where structural proximity does not imply feature similarity. In this paper, we propose DLS (Dual-Logic SAGE), a novel inductive framework designed to break the over-smoothing barrier via a "controlled instability" mechanism. Unlike conventional methods relying on static structural heuristics, DLS introduces a dynamic residual pipeline. First, a Chaotic Injection Module utilizes the Logistic Map to diversify the feature manifold, exploiting sensitivity to initial conditions to separate topologically similar but semantically distinct nodes. Second, to mitigate the aleatoric uncertainty introduced by chaotic dynamics, a Fuzzy-Logic Gating Mechanism applies soft-thresholding to filter noise and retain only high-confidence signals. Experimental results on diverse benchmarks demonstrate that DLS effectively balances feature discrimination with robustness, significantly outperforming state-of-the-art baselines in heterophilous settings while maintaining competitive efficiency on standard homophilous graphs.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 DLS（Dual-Logic SAGE）归纳式链路预测框架，用 Logistic 映射的混沌注入打散特征流形以区分拓扑相近但语义不同的节点，再用模糊逻辑门控软阈值滤噪，以「受控不稳定」缓解深层 MPNN 的过平滑，在异配图上优于基线。
AI.relevance_reason: 其混沌注入加门控残差的动态状态更新管线，可能为 LVR 多步 latent 状态中的表示坍塌与高置信信号筛选提供可核查的方法线索，但任务为图链路预测，与视觉多模态推理无直接联系。
